title: AI-assisted crop improvement: new design tools within established regulatory frameworks.
authors: Keiper, Felicity; Sanches da Rocha, Mitscheli; Beeckman, Delphine Sylvie Anne; Atanassova, Ana
one_liner_zh: 该文探讨AI辅助作物改良的监管框架，涉及深度学习用于蛋白质序列/结构预测和蛋白设计，但核心是政策视角而非蛋白质结构计算方法创新，对象为作物非蛋白体系，算法可迁移性有限。
abstract: The integration of Artificial intelligence (AI) into crop improvement offers the potential to enhance the precision, efficiency, and speed of development of new varieties. Accelerated genetic gain is promised by an increasing repertoire of AI tools for analyzing large and complex genetic and phenotypic datasets to discover and elucidate traits and predict functional variants that can be realized with the use of, inter alia, genome editing tools. This power, in combination with parallel AI tool development for optimization of genome editing processes, has generated optimism for a new era of smart breeding. This Perspective examines the regulatory implications of AI-assisted crop improvement, using illustrative examples where deep learning models have been integrated for protein sequence and structure prediction, and the optimization or design of proteins for improved or novel functionalities. The examples represent either end of a spectrum of current and emerging genome editing applications: (i) editing of endogenous genes to enhance beneficial alleles and optimize functionality; and (ii) the design and engineering of new ("de novo") protein domains for customized or new functionality. This range of outcomes can also be achieved without guidance from AI tools, albeit less efficiently, and their regulatory status is generally established. We consider relevant risks associated with these applications and contend that the regulatory status of the potential outcomes should not change, nor should they challenge the foundational applicability of existing regulatory frameworks and approaches for biotech crops. We also briefly discuss some current limitations of AI tools, and broader regulatory and governance considerations.
abstract_zh: 人工智能（AI）融入作物改良，有望提升新品种开发的精准度、效率和速度。日益增多的AI工具用于分析庞大而复杂的遗传和表型数据集，以发现和阐明性状、预测功能性变异，并可通过基因组编辑等工具实现，从而承诺加速遗传增益。这种能力，结合并行开发的用于优化基因组编辑过程的AI工具，为智能育种的新时代带来了乐观情绪。本视角文章探讨了AI辅助作物改良的监管影响，并以深度学习模型已整合用于蛋白质序列和结构预测，以及优化或设计蛋白质以增强或新功能的实例进行说明。这些实例代表了当前和新兴基因组编辑应用谱系的两端：（i）编辑内源基因以增强有利等位基因并优化功能；（ii）设计并工程化新的（“从头”）蛋白质结构域以实现定制或新功能。这些结果范围也可在没有AI工具指导的情况下实现，尽管效率较低，且其监管状态通常已确立。我们认为，与这些应用相关的风险应予以考虑，并主张潜在结果的监管状态不应改变，也不应挑战现有生物技术作物监管框架和方法的根本适用性。我们还简要讨论了AI工具当前的一些局限性，以及更广泛的监管和治理考量。
